Proceed without the figures nothing could map?

WHAT THIS ASKS

This filing used 852 tags the concept map does not know. The facts behind them were kept, not discarded, but no statement line carries them.

Sized against what did map: 304 at or above 5% of the largest revenue figure this filing reported and 548 below it. The 20 largest are on this screen; the other 832 sit behind one row beneath them. One extension element carrying the company's headline profit measure matters a great deal; forty carrying segment breakdowns nobody asked for do not. Only you can tell which this is.
